verdict.rationale: The CLI (hopp test) can run collections and generate reports, and docs describe it as usable to 'automate monitoring' from the terminal or CI, which supports scripting scheduled runs, but there's no evidence of a built-in monitor scheduler or native alerting (email/Slack) when a run fails — only external CI-based automation is implied. missing for 10: dedicated monitors feature with configurable schedule, built-in alert/notification channel on failure, dashboard for monitor history.
